description: This test ensures that the 'Delete User' functionality removes a user from the system and updates the user table accordingly.
steps: Navigate to the Admin View page.
Locate the user 'Bhhavvya Sureka' in the user table.
Click on the 'Delete User' button next to the user's details.
Confirm the user deletion in the dialog box that appears.
Verify that the user is no longer listed in the user table.
Check the backend to ensure the user is removed from the database.
Attempt to log in with the deleted user's credentials to confirm removal.
expected_results: The user is successfully removed from the system.
The user table updates to reflect the removal.
The backend database no longer contains the removed user.
edge_cases: The 'Delete User' button is disabled for certain users.
The confirmation dialog does not appear due to a network issue.
The user removal fails due to a backend error.
The user is still visible in the table after deletion.
The session times out before the deletion is confirmed.
data_requirements: User 'Bhhavvya Sureka' exists in the system.
Test data includes valid credentials for an Admin user.
Access to the Admin View page is enabled.
The database reflects the user details accurately.
The user has no dependencies preventing deletion.
dependencies: The Admin View page is accessible.
The user database is populated with valid test users.
The backend API for user deletion is functional.
performance_metrics: Time taken for the user removal API to respond.
Page load time after the user is removed.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Delete User' button is accessible with screen readers.
Verify that the dialog box is navigable using keyboard controls.
Check for sufficient color contrast on the user deletion confirmation dialog.
